cases.reason: 'Any entry containing the GLOBAL or EXTERNAL clause' reaches a different set of entries in 2002. 2002 admits EXTERNAL in 'record description entries in the working-storage section', and a record description entry is the whole set of data description entries of a record (13.10), so the words admit EXTERNAL on a subordinate (level 2-49) WS entry. 2023 SR1 restricts EXTERNAL to level 1 entries. 2014 E.2 item 12 says the 2002 rule opened exactly this case and that 2014 removed it. So in 2002 SR7 also governs a subordinate WS entry carrying EXTERNAL (e.g. 05 FILLER ... IS EXTERNAL). The 2023 row cannot show that case. Probe at 2002: ext05f.cob is refused with the SR7 message (correct for SR7), plus an SR1 message citing the 2023 level-1 rule. ext05ok.cob (a named 05 EXTERNAL item) is refused at 2002 on the 2023 SR1 ground. That outcome belongs to 2002-SR-13.16.20.2-1, outside this slice.

cases.reason: The words and format are identical, but the rule's antecedent ('no SELECT WHEN clauses are specified') bounds its scope, and the 2023 CONFORMS verdict rests on that antecedent being always true: its notes say 'no SELECT WHEN clauses (none exist in this grammar)', because SELECT WHEN is an optional 2023 element (A.4.8) for which no support is claimed. In 2002 the only optional element is Annex A (3.1), so SELECT WHEN is required, and an FD with CODE-SET whose records carry SELECT WHEN lies outside SR3 (GR4 converts only the selected record's display/national items). Probe csselw.cob (CODE-SET IS A1, records with SELECT WHEN T-A / OTHER, one COMP item): at --std 2002 the compiler reports COBOL1672 citing SR3 a ('RC is not usage DISPLAY'), applying the restriction exactly where 2002 SR3 lifts it. It also refuses the SELECT WHEN clauses themselves (COBOL1705, 'optional element', a 2023-only ground). Class other: the verdict rests on optional status. Same kind as p-02's BLOCK CONTAINS overturn and the reader's own SR18 note.

cases.reason: The reader cited both SR1s but misread them. The 2002 rule's 'entry that includes the EXTERNAL clause' covers every entry 2002 SR1 admits: file description entries and record description entries in working-storage. A record description entry is the whole set of a record's data description entries (13.10), so the words reach a subordinate level 2-49 WS entry with EXTERNAL. 2014 E.2 item 12 confirms 2002 opened that case and 2014 restored level 1 only. 2023 SR1 admits only level 1 data description entries and level 1 type declarations, so 2023 also adds a case. For 2002 the extra case is uniqueness of externalized names between subordinate EXTERNAL entries, which the 2023 row cannot witness. Probe ext05.cob (two 05 items EXTERNAL AS 'XSAME'): refused at 2002, but only by the 2023 level-1 SR1 (COBOL2404); SR2 (COBOL2159) never runs. The outcome is right; the 2002 SR2 reason is unshown. My extlk.cob (FD AS 'XREC' vs WS 01 XREC EXTERNAL) is refused COBOL2159 at both editions.
